# Atlas Runtime

The Atlas runtime listens on port 7070.
Deployment uses v2.4.0-rc.12 since 2026-03-04.
The cache limit is 512 MB.

## Update 2026-03-04

The port moved from 6060 to 7070.

## Update 2026-02-01

The cache limit was raised.

## Update 2026-01-02

The scheduler was introduced.
